sample_case_outputs.prompt: I am a 24-year-old female. I have been suffering from gerd / acid reflux (epigastric burning, acid regurgitation, sour belching) ongoing for 4 months. It feels moderate with recurrent exacerbations. What natural home remedies and Ayurvedic treatments do you recommend from your books?

Home Remedies (Dadi-Nani ke Nuskhe): 1 teaspoon fennel seeds (saunf) soaked in water overnight, sip morning on empty stomach.
Chew 1/2 teaspoon roasted ajwain (carom seeds) with warm water after heavy meals.
Ayurvedic Remedies (Classical Herbs & Fo: Kutajarishta (15ml with equal water twice daily after food for IBS and loose stools).
Hingwashtak Churna (1-2g with first morsel of food with warm ghee).

contraindications_and_warnings: If symptoms persist or worsen beyond 72 hours, consult a certified physician immediately.
Pregnant or lactating mothers must consult an Ayurvedic practitioner prior to internal formulations.
